description: MUTATES YouCanBookMe data: adds a team member to a profile. YCBM API: POST /v1/profiles/{profileId}/teammembers/items (JSON). Required: name; calendarId links the member to a calendar (find it via list_available_accounts). Use the `fields` passthrough for email, description, pic, etc. The path profileId is never sent in the body.

calendarId.description: The calendar id to link (see list_available_accounts).

fields.description: Additional documented YCBM fields to send in the JSON write body — merged OVER the typed fields above.

profileId.description: The profile (booking page) id (path only; required).

name: create_team_member
title: Add a team member
